headline: Egg Heist Chaos Mode
title: Aniimo Chaos Mode Explained | Hardest Egg Heist Tier | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want the toughest Egg Heist challenge in Aniimo? Chaos Mode arrived with version one point one. You need to reach Tier four of Elite Egg Seeker, and every run uses a Chaos Ticket. The risk is big, but so are the rewards, with higher drop rates for Prismana eggs and a chance at ultra rare secret collectibles. Teams are strongly recommended because the escape rules are strict. Would you brave Chaos Mode solo? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Chaos Mode, the hardest Operation: Egg Heist tier: needs Elite Egg Seeker Tier IV and a Chaos Ticket, with better Prismana egg drops.
